summary.text: Jerry Klein is a Republican member of the North Dakota Senate, representing District 14 (home city listed as Fessenden), serving since 1997 per the legislature's member page; the page lists the role of Assistant Majority Leader.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's biography for Klein lists an occupation of Retired Grocery Store Owner, 35 years.
It lists education as BSC; University of Mary.

It also lists Assistant Majority Leader (2013-present), President Pro Tempore (2009-2011), Past Board, Carrington Health Center, Member, Harvey Knights of Columbus, President, Fessenden Economic Development and Past Chair, ND Grocers Association.
Family is listed as: Married (Bev); 4 children; 13 grandchildren.
For the 2025 regular session, the page lists Klein's standing committee assignments as Industry and Business and Transportation.
